# Amit Samant

> Senior iOS Engineer. Writing about Swift, iOS, and software engineering.

Amit Samant is a Senior iOS Engineer at Rakuten Viki in Singapore, a WWDC20 Swift
Student Challenge winner, and an organizer of Swift Bengaluru and Swift Bharat.
This site is his blog about Swift, iOS, and software engineering.

## Posts

- [What's New in SwiftUI](https://amitsamant.dev/blog/posts/whats-new-in-swiftui) (2026-06-11): A summary of everything new in SwiftUI at WWDC 2026 — refreshed look and feel, document-based app APIs, new interaction primitives, and data flow improvements.
